name: vr-portal
usedBy: Skeet-Game (from v0.14; runs inside the home from v0.23)
VR-FruitSlicer (from v0.13; runs inside the home from v0.18)

pattern.recursion: picture split into overlapping half-size parts (VRE.subdivide), depth 1 in use, any depth available
pattern.v2: one ring, seen by both eyes through the mirror rule; every pickable thing is a flat patch with a size in degrees (3 at least); windows and icons sit on one ball of radius 1.5 m round the head
pattern.nesting: a page inside a page: the home screen (a cell) runs a game (a cell) in a frame and lends it its camera, sound and motion through one note, VRE_HOST; the game finds it as VRE.host. The same rule one level down, depth 1 only: a hosted page does not host
pattern.depthLimit: depth 1: nine parts; each extra level quadruples the looks needed to scan the picture
